synthesis: iHIM codebase shows emerging technical debt across 3 critical domains: (1) API Layer - CORS misconfiguration, deprecated datetime.utcnow() calls (5 instances), inconsistent error response formats, bare exception handling swallowing errors silently. (2) Actions/Registry - fragile multi-step actions with incomplete error context, dependency bugs in utils.py (hard-coded paths, command injection) and spawner.py (global state race conditions), non-standard response formats. (3) Error Handling & Logging - widespread silent failures: 7+ locations with bare 'except Exception: pass', unused exception variables, no logging framework, difficult to debug failures. Core infrastructure functions (load_stopwatches, load_tasks, load_notes) fail silently when JSON corrupted. Pattern: quick-and-working prototype code that needs consolidation before scaling.
priority_areas: CRITICAL: Fix CORS security misconfiguration (allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True violates spec)
CRITICAL: Fix utils.py hard-coded paths and command injection vulnerabilities (breaks on non-local machines)
CRITICAL: Fix team/spawner.py global state and process handle tracking (race conditions in multi-threaded context)
HIGH: Implement centralized logging (DEBUG level minimum) across main.py, actions, and spawner
HIGH: Replace deprecated datetime.utcnow() with timezone-aware datetime.now(timezone.utc) (5 instances in main.py)
HIGH: Standardize API response format: {success, data?, error?, error_type?, status_code}
HIGH: Replace bare 'except Exception: pass' with specific exception handling and logging (7+ locations found)
MEDIUM: Extract path constants to config.py (path construction scattered across codebase)
MEDIUM: Fix UUID truncation (8-char IDs collision risk) - use full UUID for production
MEDIUM: Consolidate optional imports try/except blocks (7 duplicated patterns)

reliability: silent failures with no logging (7+ bare except blocks)
JSON corruption not validated on load
maintainability: inconsistent error response formats across endpoints
scalability: file-based JSON persistence for all data
no caching on frequent file I/O operations
global state in spawner.py not thread-safe

2. Implement logging module with DEBUG level across all packages (main.py, actions, spawner, utils)
3. Fix CORS to specific allowed origins only
4. Audit and fix utils.py path handling and subprocess command construction
5. Audit spawner.py for thread-safety (global state, process handle tracking)
